title: XMH: Explainable Metaheuristics via Exact-Coalition Operator-Level Shapley Value Attribution
description: Python framework for exact Shapley value attribution at the operator level in metaheuristic algorithms. Includes instrumented implementations of DE, GA, PSO, CMA-ES, SHADE and JADE, four attribution methods, and the raw per-run coalition values behind every quantitative claim of the manuscript. Version 1.4.0 adds the comparison against IOHxplainer, the reference implementation of hyperparameter-sensitivity analysis for iterative optimisation heuristics, so the paper's complementarity claim rests on the published tool rather than on a stand-in; it ships the container the comparison needs, since IOHxplainer cannot be installed in a modern environment. Versions 1.3.0 and earlier remain included.
